messages:
Sahil: Heads up — experiment: tie region ejection weight to customer tier + model-variant cold-cache penalty. Trying to avoid big customers getting routed to cheap quantized variants during region flaps.
Jen: oof yeah we've seen that. can you sketch decision flow?
Dan: short: prefer same-region for P1/P2 unless latency > X or region at capacity. if fall back, try full-precision variant before quantized for premium tenants.
Marco: how do we measure "cold-cache penalty"? warm KV cache in same region matters a lot for long-chat sessions.
Sahil: we estimate cold-cache penalty by sampling recent KV hits for tenant/model combo. if <0.2 hit-rate => add penalty score to remote region latency.
Sahil: rough pseudocode:
```
score(region) = measured_rtt(region) + ejection_penalty(region)
if tenant.tier in ["enterprise","pro"]:
  score_variant(full_precision) = score + variant_penalty(full_precision)
  score_variant(quant) = score + variant_penalty(quant) + cold_cache_penalty
  choose min(score_variant)
else:
  choose min(score + variant_penalty)
```
Jen: Variant penalties := expected token-ms cost delta. remember quant perf varies by seq_len.
Luke: nit: quant can be faster for short sequences, slower for long ones depending on kernel. include seq_len distribution in variant_penalty.
Dan: agree. add seq_len_bucket factor to variant_penalty.
Marco: UX question — how visible should this be in Console? Ops want to know when premium tenants are getting quantized fallbacks.
Jen: Console idea: per-tenant routing trace -> show region chosen, variant chosen, decision score breakdown (rtt, ejection, cache_penalty, seq_len_factor). toggle show_human_readable_scores: boolean.
Sahil: also add rollout control: canary percent where premium tenants excluded from quantized fallback for N days. gate by tenant tags.
ops-bot: deploy scheduled: rollout/routing-experiments/v3 -> canary=10% at 2026-03-22T02:00Z :rocket:
Marco: test plan: simulate us-west outage and ensure enterprise tenants failover to eu-west full-precision rather than us-central quantized pool.
Luke: telemetry: add histogram fallback_type per tenant_tier, gauge cold_cache_hit_rate per tenant/model/region. alert if enterprise quantized_fallbacks > 1% sustained.
Dan: Also log compact decision blob per request for offline eval: {tenant, region_scores, variant_scores, chosen, reason}. compress with protobuf. retention 30d default.
Jen: dev-api: add optional header X-Redwood-Routing-Trace: true to opt-in per-request scoring in response for debugging. off by default.
Sahil: open Q: how do we price this? shouldn't silently use expensive full-precision for enterprise unless contracted. tie to tier config + spend cap.
Marco: implement soft-budget throttle: if tenant.spend_rate > threshold, re-enable quantized fallback even for premium but notify and mark route as budget_capped.
Luke: TL;DR: tier -> prefer same-region, add cold-cache penalty, include seq_len and kernel perf in variant penalty, expose trace in Console, telemetry+alerts, canary rollout + spend cap.
Jen: thanks. i'll draft RFC with config fields + console mockups.
Sahil: I'll pair with jen on RFC and add unit tests for score calc. ping if you want me to own the canary.
Marco: added to #routing-experiments board.
Jen: @sahil @dan @marco great sync. RFC by EOD Wed, then canary scheduling.
